subject: Marketplace milestone payout & revenue allocation request (HoloHealth)
messages:
From: Julia Hart <julia.hart@holohealth.com>
To: Ethan Park <ethan_park@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 27 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Marketplace private offer: milestone payout and rev-share structure

Hi Ethan / Marissa,

Thanks again for last week's demo. We're preparing a private offer request for our pilot and need to propose a non-standard revenue allocation tied to staged milestones. High level: 3 milestones over 12 months (PO issuance, 50% deployment, 100% production), with payment tied to milestone acceptance. HoloHealth is requesting a 20% rev-share for year 1, then step-down to 12% as usage stabilizes.

Key asks from procurement:
- Confirmation that Redwood can accommodate milestone-triggered payouts in the private offer (not just simple monthly invoices).
- Clarity on whether rev-share can be applied to gross marketplace revenue or if Redwood requires net-of-fees calculation.
- Invoice timing: HoloHealth prefers Net 90 but can agree to Net 45 with an early-pay credit.

I've attached the RFP overview (HoloHealth_RFP.pdf) and a simple expected-volume curve. Can we schedule a call this week to align commercial structure and any marketplace constraints?

Thanks,

Julia Hart
Head of Procurement, HoloHealth
procurement@holohealth.com
Attachments: HoloHealth_RFP.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Ethan Park <ethan_park@redwood.ai>
To: Julia Hart <julia.hart@holohealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 27 Oct 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Marketplace private offer: milestone payout and rev-share structure

Hi Julia — appreciate the clear spec and the RFP.

Short answer: we can support milestone-based settlement in a private offer but there are two buckets to confirm: marketplace policy constraints (AWS/GCP/Azure differ) and internal deal desk approval for a stepped rev-share. I'll loop Legal and Deal Desk for a quick review.

Proposed next steps:
1) Quick sync (30 min) to confirm milestone definitions and acceptance criteria — are these formal acceptance gates or HoloHealth signoffs?
2) I'll open an internal escalation for approval for the stepped rev-share and the extended invoice terms.
3) Marketplace alignment: we'll confirm whether rev-share is calculated on gross list price or after marketplace fees.

Marissa — want to lead the call with Julia? I can handle internal coordination.

Thanks,
Ethan
Ethan Park
Senior Account Exec, Redwood Inference
ethan_park@redwood.ai

From: Ethan Park <ethan_park@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 28 Oct 2026 08:03:00 -0700
Subject: INTERNAL: Escalation — HoloHealth private offer (milestone payouts + stepped rev-share)

Team — looping you in for exec clearance. I summarized the economics below; attaching a short worksheet (deal_summary.xlsx).

Opportunity: HoloHealth pilot -> enterprise rollout, expected 12-month $1.2M ARR ramp (pilot to production).
Proposed commercial (ask from customer):
- Milestone payouts on acceptance: 30% on PO, 40% on 50% deployment, 30% on production sign-off.
- Rev-share: 20% of marketplace revenue in Year 1, then 12% thereafter.
- Invoice terms: customer requests Net 90; willing to take Net 45 with an early-pay credit equal to 1.5% per 30 days early.

Risks & considerations:
- Marketplace engines (AWS) prefer fixed rev-share tables; milestone-triggered payouts may require custom invoice mapping and manual reconciliation.
- Gross vs net base: if rev-share is on gross, Redwood bears marketplace fee asymmetry; if on net, we need to define which fees are deducted.
- Legal will need a clawback clause if milestones fail or usage falls below thresholds.

Request: Executive approval to proceed with a conditional private offer that:
A) Accepts stepped rev-share (20% -> 12%) for the first 18 months,
B) Permits milestone-triggered invoicing but requires finance signoff for reconciliation process,
C) Approves Net 45 with the proposed early-pay credit (as an alternative to Net 90).

If we get a green light, I'll coordinate with AWS Marketplace on the technical mapping and with Legal on contract language.

Attachments: deal_summary.xlsx

- Ethan

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Ethan Park <ethan_park@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 29 Oct 2026 10:21:00 -0700
Subject: Re: INTERNAL: Escalation — HoloHealth private offer (milestone payouts + stepped rev-share)

Thanks Ethan — reviewed the worksheet. I'm supportive in principle but need Finance and Legal to sign off on two items before I can give formal executive concurrence: 

1) Reconciliation workflow for milestone payouts — Finance must confirm that the ERP can handle partial milestone billing and that we have a process to net marketplace fees correctly.
2) Clarity on rev-share base (gross vs net) and a simple clawback tied to usage thresholds.

One alternative to accelerate: agree to Net 45 + 1.5% early-pay credit (as you proposed) but require HoloHealth to accept electronic milestone confirmations (Doc link or signed acceptance) to minimize dispute risk.

Marissa — please capture these as gating items in the commercial redlines document and ask Julia to confirm acceptance of e-sign milestone confirmations.

I'll provisionally approve the stepped rev-share pending Finance/Legal notes.

Karthik Iyer
VP, Global Sales

From: AWS Marketplace Sales <awsmp-sales@amazon.com>
To: Ethan Park <ethan_park@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Julia Hart <julia.hart@holohealth.com>
Date: Fri, 30 Oct 2026 14:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Marketplace private offer: milestone payout and rev-share structure

Hi all — copying in Marketplace ops. Quick notes from the marketplace side: 

- Private offers can support non-standard payout schedules but they must be represented in the offer metadata and invoicing will be tied to the seller (Redwood) invoice lifecycle. We cannot natively schedule marketplace payouts per-milestone without a reconciliation mapping file.
- Rev-share baseline: we recommend calculating rev-share on pre-discount list price less marketplace fees (so closer to gross but excluding marketplace fee). We'll need a firm definition to lock the private offer.
- For Net 90 requests, some sellers accept but it often requires an early-pay credit or a deferred revenue recognition clause. AWS will honor whatever Redwood sets in the private offer; the operational burden will be on Redwood Finance for reconciliation and reporting.

Please provide a one-page commercial summary and the desired field values for the private offer (rev-share %, invoice terms, milestone identifiers). I'll route to Marketplace ops for a technical mapping estimate.

Regards,
AWS Marketplace Sales
awsmp-sales@amazon.com

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Ethan Park <ethan_park@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 02 Nov 2026 14:38:00 -0700
Subject: Re: INTERNAL: Escalation — HoloHealth private offer (milestone payouts + stepped rev-share)

Team — after quick sync with Finance and Legal this morning, we can approve the private offer with the following conditions: 

1) Rev-share will be applied to pre-discount list price less documented marketplace fees (Finance will provide the fee schedule).
2) Milestone payouts are permitted provided HoloHealth agrees to e-signed acceptance for each milestone; Redwood Finance will own reconciliation and produce quarterly statements.
3) Invoice terms: Net 45 with the 1.5% per-30-day early-pay credit. Net 90 is allowed only with explicit Finance exception and higher clawback threshold.

This is executive approval to proceed to commercial redlines and to engage AWS Marketplace ops for mapping. Please attach the short commercial summary and send to awsmp-sales for technical estimate.

Exec approval attached: exec_approval_signoff.pdf

- Lauren Bishop
Director, Deal Desk & Pricing, Redwood Inference
